items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would write the same way for Gloria Lynne – if I wrote for Dinah – one of those arrangements for Dinah... Last time I saw him he was pianist for Dinah Washington. Oh yeah – how was that? How was Dinah to work with? She gave you no problems. No. Everybody – no problems.

ctx.x: That tells the difference right there. Right now we’re going to listen to a tune by Gloria Lynne that Melba wrote – an original tune with strings. It’s called We Never Kissed. Ain’t That a Shame? [Actually We Never Kissed, What a Shame; the music plays.]
The difference is who picks what songs. Dinah picks some soul songs. Gloria picks some . . .
